arraial.livro.selecionado: Blueprint in the book: %s. Right-click a Construction Marker to apply it.
arraial.livro.escolha_primeiro: Pick a blueprint first: right-click in the air with the book (sneak to go back).
arraial.canteiro.sem_arquivo: This blueprint's structure file was not found!
arraial.canteiro.obra_em_andamento: Construction already started! Break the marker to cancel.

arraial.canteiro.sem_bau: Place a chest next to the marker with the materials.
arraial.canteiro.tudo_pronto: The chest has everything this build needs!
arraial.vila.dica: Build houses with beds: every free bed attracts a new villager. Right-click the Village Cross to see the village.
arraial.vila.muito_perto: There is already a village less than %s blocks from here.
arraial.vila.sem_vaga: No free beds: build more houses for the village to grow.
arraial.morador.dispensado: %s is no longer a %s and will look for other work in the village.
arraial.morador.foi_embora: %s left the village for lack of food.
arraial.vila.sem_armazem: No Storehouse: the villagers have nowhere to store or get food!
arraial.cronica.dica: Right-click the Village Cross with a book to take a copy of the full chronicle.
arraial.cronica.chegada: %s came to live in the village.
arraial.lenhador.esperando_mudas: waiting for the saplings to grow
arraial.cronica.ovelhas: %s traded wheat for two sheep at the fair.
arraial.cava.acabou: the pit is exhausted: move the workstation
arraial.cronica.eleicao: %s took office as %s of the arraial.
arraial.vila.pedido_armazem: The mayor needs a Storehouse to plan buildings.

arraial.vila.pedido_lugar: The mayor wants to build %s, but found no flat, free ground.
arraial.vila.sem_prefeito: No mayor: with %s moradores the arraial elects its oldest resident.
arraial.canteiro.prioridade_dica: (sneak + right-click with an empty hand to change)
arraial.pedreiro.reservado: %s is reserved for a more urgent site
arraial.pastor.expedicao: looking for animals in the wild
arraial.cronica.trouxe: %s brought %s animal(s) from the wild to the corral.
arraial.cronica.trouxe_escolta: %s brought %s animal(s) from the wild to the corral, escorted by %s.
arraial.cronica.remanejou: %s told %s to leave the %s trade and find other work.
arraial.prefeito.gabinete: holding office at the Town Hall

arraial.crise.aviso.enchente: Flood in %s! The storm made the water rise.
arraial.crise.aviso.praga: Plague in %s! Caterpillars are eating the crops.
arraial.crise.aviso.salteadores: Rumours of bandits around %s. They should strike tonight!
arraial.crise.ataque: %s bandits are raiding %s! Protect the storehouse!

arraial.cronica.crise.seca: A drought began. The fields cracked.
arraial.cronica.crise.seca_poco: A drought began, but water from the well is saving the fields.
arraial.cronica.crise.enchente: A flood came with the storm.
arraial.cronica.crise.praga: A plague of caterpillars appeared in the fields.
arraial.cronica.crise.praga_galinhas: A plague of caterpillars appeared in the fields, but the chickens are keeping them down.
arraial.cronica.crise.salteadores: Word went round that bandits are prowling near the village.

arraial.cronica.fim.salteadores: The bandits never showed up after all.

arraial.cronica.fim.salteadores_fugiram: The bandits fled at dawn without taking anything.
